description: Na₄Zr(MoO₄)₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/a space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.56 Å. Zr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.24 Å) and four longer (2.25 Å) Zr-O bond lengths. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.86 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Mo atom.
